justification: Live /api/property hit the 30 s gateway limit (504) when one NSW map call stalled: ~14 calls had no timeout. And a failed hazard call was swallowed and shown as 'No' (bush fire, mine subsidence, contaminated land) on the LEP tab, SEE/DA report, assessment reports, pattern-book check and property cards. Now every map call has an 8 s deadline and a failed or timed-out hazard is unknown, shown as 'Not checked'.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A failed or stalled hazard call becomes false/'No', or a reader prints 'No' for unknown.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Run by the main session 2026-10-21: reverting the bushfire unknown branch to false -> 3 fail; making the LEP tile ignore not-checked -> 1 fails; clean 15/15. Full suite 170 suites / 2194 tests pass, tsc 0.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live 2026-10-21: /api/property 504 at 30.4-30.7 s on 2 of 3 tries; bushfire map stalled 40 s, TOD 11.4 s on first try then ~0.1-0.2 s.

pre_impl.existing_data: Three-state model copied from scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py get_bushfire_live ('Not assessed', never 'Clear').
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: reports.ts read non-existent floodPlanning / mineSubsidenceDistrict (always 'No'); pattern-book read anefValue, never set (aircraft noise never excluded) — both fixed. Pattern-book now CONDITIONAL, not ELIGIBLE, when bush fire or flood is unknown.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: fetch-timeout helper, hazard-unchecked helper, uncheckedHazards list on constraints, readers updated.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A NSW ArcGIS map that stalls (40 s seen) or returns an error body: now a deadline/no-answer result, recorded in constraints.uncheckedHazards, never parsed as 'no features'.
pre_impl.frontend_type: bushfireProne is boolean | null; mine subsidence / contaminated land / ANEF / coastal carry unknown via uncheckedHazards; readers check unknown before printing yes/no.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: a buyer or certifier read 'Bushfire Prone: No' or a report row 'No' for a lot nobody checked, or the page failed with HTTP 504. After: 'Not checked — the government map did not answer', and the page loads.

functions.name: fetchWithTimeout
functions.input: a NSW map url and the 8 second deadline
functions.output: the parsed answer, or an explicit no-answer result on timeout or ArcGIS error
functions.if_none: no answer at all becomes unknown and is never read as No

values.value: 8 s per call; corner-lot retries 4 s + 6 s

break_it.scenario: A NSW government map service never answers the property lookup request.
break_it.what_happens: The whole property lookup would run past the 30 s gateway limit.
break_it.how: 8 s deadline; test with a never-resolving fetch returns in time with that hazard unknown.

break_it.scenario: The bush fire prone land map returns an error instead of features.
break_it.what_happens: The lot would be shown as not bush fire prone.
break_it.how: bushfireProne null + uncheckedHazards; LEP tile, SEE intake, reports print 'Not checked'.

break_it.scenario: A page or report reader still prints No when the hazard value is unknown.
break_it.what_happens: A report says No for a hazard nobody checked.
break_it.how: Each reader updated and tested; LEP tile break fails 1 test.

break_it.scenario: The SEE/DA intake receives an unknown bush fire value.
break_it.what_happens: The DA bundle would record bush fire as 'no'.
break_it.how: Intake leaves the question unanswered for null (agent mutation 4).

break_it.scenario: Pattern-book eligibility with bush fire or flood unknown.
break_it.what_happens: A lot would be called ELIGIBLE without the hazard being checked.
break_it.how: Now CONDITIONAL when either is unknown (agent change; more addresses will read CONDITIONAL).

mutation_analysis: Two breaks run by the main session (A: 3 fail, B: 1 fails); the agent ran 7 more, one per fix.

post_merge.manual_verify: Live: 8 Hollands Ave and 165 Belmore Rd North under 10 s on 5 tries each with no 504; the page loads and shows the summary.

residual_risk: Bushfire DCP rules still show only on a firm yes (scope decision). property-data.ts fills acidSulfateSoils 'Class 5' and basixWater '40%' when data is missing (pre-existing, separate fix).
